title: Applications Open: Microbiology Division Internship Programme
bodyHtml:
Applications Open: Microbiology Division Internship Programme

IPC invites applications for one internship position in its Microbiology Division.

Eligibility:

M.Sc. Microbiology, M.Sc. Biotechnology, M.Sc. Molecular Biology or M.Pharm. Pharmaceutical Biotechnology.

Preference will be given to candidates with dissertation/project experience from reputed R&D institutions and knowledge of microbiological and molecular techniques.

Application period: 25 September–10 October 2026

Deadline: 10 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM

Duration: One year

Interested candidates may apply through the Google Form/QR code provided on the IPC website under the News & Highlights section.

Application Link:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSezZQQpuqQr7kjCeD1Gtf9Oa0_HnUSn3k0jGxAYCLisUAjnHQ/viewform?usp=publish-editor (opens in a new tab)
